# Carnival Glam Hub

> Premium Carnival-morning concierge for travelling masqueraders across Trinidad, Jamaica, Miami, Toronto, Grenada (Spice Mas), Saint Lucia, Antigua, and Barbados (Crop Over). Founded 2017 by Kibwe McGann and celebrity makeup artist Gabby Glam (Gabrielle Waite). Trusted by 15,000+ masqueraders.
